commands:
set -e
TOOLS=/home/aitr/projects/CompilerSutraAppFarm/tools
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$TOOLS/lib/pkgconfig:${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}
export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$TOOLS:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}
# Patch out forced -fno-exceptions for client-only smoke build
find . -name '*.cmake' -print0 | xargs -0 sed -i 's/-fno-exceptions/-fexceptions/g' || true
cmake -S . -B build \
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${CC:-clang}" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${CXX:-clang++}" \
  -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-O2" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-O2 -fexceptions" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DWITHOUT_SERVER=ON -DWITH_UNIT_TESTS=OFF -DWITH_TEST_SUITE=OFF \
  -DWITH_CURL=OFF -DWITH_SSL=system -DDOWNLOAD_BOOST=ON -DWITH_BOOST=boost
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)" --target mysql || cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"

command: find build -name mysql -type f | head -1 | grep -q .

workload: find build -name mysql -type f | head -1 | grep -q .
